PDEFIND and Weak SINDy documentation

These two notebooks demonstrate the use of pysindy to discover partial differential equations (PDEs) from data. The first notebook recreates the results from Rudy et al. (2017) “Data-driven discovery of partial differential equations”.

The second adapts several examples from the former and additional ones from Reinbold et al. (2020) “Using noisy or incomplete data to discover models of spatiotemporal dynamics”.

Examples are run on python 3.12. See requirements.txt for dependencies.
